messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired for service=autoscaler-controller (sev=P2) - queue_length=32482, average_latency=1.8s, 5m error_rate=3.2% :rotating_light:
pagerduty: page unacked -> paging alex (oncall)
alex (oncall): acked. I'm on it. Can someone grab recent prometheus graphs?
sam: grabbing charts now. queue growth started ~10:12 UTC, slope steep after 10:18. autoscaler pods are green but no scale-up events in logs.
lee: checking leader election / kubeapi throttling. seeing API 429s to provider during last 6m.
maria: customer impact: a subset of requests are queued >30s; frontend circuit-breakers triggered for some tenants. Not widespread but definitely affecting streaming inference jobs.
alex (oncall): summary for PD -> autoscaler not reacting, requests piling, manual mitigation if needed. Who can run a manual scale?
eng-platform: I can run a manual bump, but want to inspect if it's a control-plane or provider quota problem. If provider quota, manual scale will fail.
sam: logs from autoscaler-controller: 
```
2026-01-15T10:19:21Z WARN reconcile failed: provider API error: 429 Too Many Requests
2026-01-15T10:19:23Z INFO desired_replicas=0 current_replicas=120 pending_queue=28600
2026-01-15T10:19:30Z INFO scaling skipped due to provider-rate-limit,retry_after=15s
```
lee: provider API is rate-limited. We're hitting our per-minute quota for instance API.
alex (oncall): ok that explains no scale events. Can we fail over to other region or use reserved capacity burst pool?
eng-platform: reserved-burst pool has limited capacity but can take a portion. I can route some queued work to burst nodes while we sort quotas. Need a config change to routing policy (10%->burst). Anyone run the routing update?
maria: approve. Customer impact reduces if we route non-critical tenants to burst; keep critical pinned.
sam: on it. Pushing route change:
```
POST /api/v1/routing/policy
{ "route": "burst_pool", "percentage": 10, "match": "tenant.tier != \"enterprise\"" }
```
sam: route change applied. Starting drain of oldest queue items to burst nodes. queue_length -> 28740 -> 26500 (progressing).
alex (oncall): good. Next: request provider quota increase from cloud team, and open a fallback to spinup smaller preemptible instances (faster quota). Who has permission?
eng-platform: handing to lee for quota request. Lee, please tag cloud-admins and eng-infra.
lee: pinging @cloud-admins and filing ticket. Requesting temporary quota bump + explain we're hitting autoscaler reconciliation throttling. Also starting spin-up of preemptible pool as a contingency.
alex (oncall): while that's happening, keep monitoring latency and customer-facing signals. Maria, can you update customer-ops Slack? We might need to notify a handful of affected tenants.
maria: will draft a short advisory: "Experiencing degraded throughput for some streaming workloads due to autoscaler API rate limits; mitigation in progress, routing to burst pool to reduce queue. ETA 15-30m."
sam: metrics: 10m CPU per autoscaler-controller pod trending down (controller busy waiting on API), node provisioning requests queued with cloud provider = 42 pending.
eng-platform: started preemptible spin-up. Command: 
```
./infra/provision --pool=preemptible-fast --count=40 --image=redwood-inference:v1.2.3
```
alex (oncall): nice. Keep an eye on KV cache warmup: moving work to new nodes can create hot KV prefix misses and temporarily increase latency. Use suffix-led routing for burst pool to reduce prefix collisions.
sam: toggled suffix routing flag for burst_pool: true.
lee: cloud-admins replied, approving emergency transient quota increase + advising backoff: apply 429 backoff patch to autoscaler reconciliation loop.
alex (oncall): assign a quick patch to reduce aggressive retries (backoff to jittered exponential). Sam/Lee can we do a hotfix?
sam: I can prepare a small hotfix patch and deploy a canary to 1 controller pod. Patch: change retry from fixed 15s -> exp backoff jitter (min=5s,max=60s). Pushing PR now.
lee: infra applied preemptible nodes, 30/40 up and joining cluster. queue_length -> 18890. Latency median -> 600ms, tail 95th -> 7s.
maria: customer update sent. No escalations yet.
alex (oncall): deploy hotfix to canary. If healthy, roll to rest. Also keep PD aware.
sam: canary deployed to controller-7, logs show reduced error churn and fewer immediate retries. PR merged and rolling.
incident-bot: PagerDuty note: alex acknowledged the page at 10:21 UTC, pager escalations paused.
lee: autoscaler logs post-hotfix: fewer immediate API calls, better backoff. We should avoid bouncing provider with retries. Monitoring quota consumption.
eng-platform: routing stayed stable; burst nodes absorbing ~9k queued items. Manual scale was avoided.
alex (oncall): status check: queue_length 11,200 -> trending down. Preemptible nodes healthy. Cloud quota ticket pending but approved transiently. Any remaining customer issues?
maria: a few streaming jobs saw reconnects; I'm coordinating with solutions-eng to reconcile dropped sessions. No broad outages.
sam: recommend follow-ups: 1) add guardrail to autoscaler to detect provider 429 and pause/reduce reconcilers, 2) add metric alert for provider error_rate > 1% to avoid paging until degraded for 3m, 3) postmortem to capture root cause and runbook updates.
alex (oncall): agreed. I'll file the incident and assign owners. For now, mark page resolved if metrics keep improving.
pagerduty: incident acknowledged by alex (oncall), status=ongoing -> resolved pending verification.
alex (oncall): resolving PD page, we'll continue monitoring from rotation. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
sam: leaving a short diagnostic snippet for postmortem: 
```
root cause: provider API quota exhausted due to large concurrent provisioning and aggressive autoscaler retries
mitigations: routing to burst_pool, preemptible spinup, autoscaler backoff hotfix, transient quota increase
actions: postmortem, runbook update, provider quota baseline increase
```
lee: will follow up with cloud-admins for permanent quota change and to add provider-side rate metrics to our dashboards.
maria: I'll draft the customer-facing postmortem note after the internal one.
alex (oncall): last check: queue_length=4120, avg_latency=240ms, error_rate=0.4%. Closing thread in 30m unless regression. Great job.
incident-bot: PagerDuty incident resolved by alex (oncall) at 10:49 UTC.
